    Class
    Description
    BuildingsRefillDTO
    Patch telling the client to wipe and replenish the buildings currently on display.
    ChooseTotemColorDTO
    Tells the clients that someone has chosen their designated totem color.
    DTOVisitor
    Base visitor allowing UI or logic pieces to hook into specific update events.
    EndGameDTO
    Signals the end of the game and updates the client's bottom row with the final state.
    EraChangeDTO
    Alerts the client that times are changing and a new Era has begun.
    ErrorDTO
    Packs up server errors into a tiny DTO throwable brick that prints right on the client interface.
    EventResolvedDTO
    Broadcasts that an event card has been successfully resolved.
    GameResumeDTO
    Transmits a complete snapshot of the game state to allow a client to resume an ongoing match after a disconnection or crash.
    LeaderboardChangeDTO
    Delivers the latest ranking scores straight to the small model when prestige or ties have shifted.
    LobbyInitializedDTO
    The "kickoff" DTO.
    MesosStartedDTO
    Lightweight ping indicating the final 'Mesos is running' state.
    PhaseChangeDTO
    Notifies the client that the game state machine has stepped into a new phase.
    PickBottomBuildingsDTO
    Lets the UI know someone picked up a building card from the bottom row.
    PickBottomRowDTO
    Broadcasts out that a character or event card got picked up from the bottom row.
    PickTopBuildingsDTO
    Lets the UI know someone picked up a building card from the top row.
    PickTopRowDTO
    Broadcasts out that a character or event card got picked up from the top row.
    PlayerJoinedLobbyDTO
    Notifies the client that the lobby composition has changed.
    PlayerRecapDTO
    Updates a specific player's aggregated statistics and collections.
    PlayerResourcesChangeDTO
    Refreshes a player's resource stash (like food, prestige, or free draw counters) without touching the rest of the board.
    PlayerStateChangeDTO
    Signals when a player's turn status switches on or off, or if they unlock the ability to skip.
    RoundChangeDTO
    Lightweight dto alerting the client model to tick the round counter up.
    SmallModelEditor
    The core contract for any update packet hopping over the network.
    TopRowRefillDTO
    A dto package containing the fully replenished top (and consequently shifted bottom) display row of characters and events.
    TotemOfferMoveDTO
    Tells the UI that a player successfully locked their totem into a slot on the offer track.
    TotemTurnMoveDTO
    Broadcasts that a player's totem has been moved back from the offer track to a specific index on the turn order tile.
